metadata.title: That 1 kill where Valorant said ‘Sure, take it... I’m confused too’ LOL
metadata.description:
Wait, I wasn’t ready and still got the kill?
Enemy must’ve been on a snack break.
Click if your aim’s a mess but the game gifts you anyway.
Valorant logic doing all the work here.

Tap if your kills come from pure chaos!

#valorant #funnygaming #luckshot #gamingfails #shorts
